The Challenge

See the Future of Your Sales

Demand forecasting is the foundation of effective retail planning — yet many retailers still rely on historical averages or manual guesses. These approaches fail to capture seasonality, trends, promotional impacts, and unexpected external factors, leading to costly mismatches between supply and demand.

Our Demand Forecasting service uses advanced machine learning to generate highly accurate sales predictions. We incorporate a wide range of internal and external data — sales history, inventory, promotions, weather, holidays, and economic trends — to build robust forecasting models.

We deliver forecasts at multiple levels: product, category, store, region, and total. Our models automatically adjust to changing patterns, ensuring you always have the most current and reliable demand projections. We also provide scenario planning, so you can test the impact of different strategies.

Reduce uncertainty, optimize inventory, and make smarter decisions with our predictive insights.

Demand Forecasting

Our Approach

Data Integration & Time‑Series Aggregation

We connect to your POS, e‑commerce, inventory, and external data sources (weather, holidays, economic indicators). We aggregate historical sales data into a clean, time‑series format optimized for forecasting.

Exploratory Data Analysis & Pattern Discovery

We analyze sales patterns — seasonality, trends, cyclicality, and promotional impacts. We identify key drivers of demand, enabling us to build robust forecasting models that capture underlying behavior.

Model Development & Selection

We develop multiple forecasting models — ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing, and machine learning (XGBoost, LSTM). We select the best‑performing model for each product category and location, balancing accuracy and interpretability.

Scenario Planning & What‑If Analysis

We enable you to simulate different scenarios — promotional intensity, supply disruptions, or market shifts. You can assess how changes in key drivers affect demand, enabling proactive decision‑making.

Forecast Integration & Automation

We integrate forecasts directly into your planning systems — inventory replenishment, workforce scheduling, and budgeting. We automate forecast updates, ensuring you always have the most current predictions.

Forecast Accuracy Monitoring & Improvement

We continuously track forecast accuracy against actual sales. We retrain models as new data arrives, and we refine approaches to minimize error and adapt to changing market conditions.

What We Deliver

Granular Demand Forecasts

Product‑level, category‑level, and store‑level forecasts with confidence intervals — updated automatically.

Scenario Planning & Sensitivity Analysis

Interactive tools to model the impact of promotions, price changes, or external events on future demand.

Forecast Accuracy Reporting

Continuous tracking of forecast error (MAPE, RMSE) with automated model retraining to maintain accuracy.

Integration with Planning Systems

Seamless export of forecasts to your inventory, procurement, and workforce planning tools.

Promotional Lift & Cannibalization Analysis

Detailed assessment of promotion effectiveness, enabling smarter marketing spend and inventory allocation.

Automated Alerts & Anomaly Detection

Notify you when actual demand deviates significantly from forecasts, enabling rapid response.

Core Capabilities

Short‑ & Long‑Term Forecasting

Generate daily, weekly, monthly, and seasonal forecasts tailored to your planning horizons — from immediate replenishment to annual budgeting.

Product & Category‑Level Forecasting

Obtain granular forecasts for individual SKUs, product categories, and store‑location combinations, enabling targeted inventory and promotion decisions.

Promotional Lift Analysis

Quantify the impact of promotions on baseline demand. Distinguish between incremental sales and cannibalization, enabling smarter marketing spend.

Anomaly & Outlier Detection

Automatically detect and handle outliers — such as supply disruptions or sudden demand spikes — ensuring forecasts remain robust and reliable.

Forecast Visualization & Reporting

Interactive dashboards that show forecasts, confidence intervals, and actuals, with drill‑down to product and location levels.

Integrated Demand Sensing

Incorporate real‑time signals — competitor pricing, social media trends, weather — to adjust forecasts dynamically and stay responsive.
